values.en:
Work in the section's context of a topological space $X$ with basepoint $x$. Write $[p]=\operatorname{mk}(p)$, $e_x=\operatorname{Path.refl}(x)$, $p\star q=\operatorname{Path.trans}(p,q)$, and $\bar p=\operatorname{Path.symm}(p)$; $\star$ traverses $p$ first and then $q$, and $\simeq$ denotes homotopy relative to the endpoints. The section defines $[p]\cdot[q]=[p\star q]$, $1=[e_x]$, and $[p]^{-1}=[\bar p]$. Independence of representatives for multiplication and inversion was proved in `FundamentalGroup.mul.proof` and `FundamentalGroup.inv.proof`, respectively. It remains to verify the group axioms, without claiming strict associativity of paths.

By [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/Path.lean#L303-L308), arbitrary $A,B,C\in\pi_1(X,x)$ have loop representatives $p,q,r:x\to x$ with $A=[p],B=[q],C=[r]$. By [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/Path.lean#L318-L319), $[u]=[v]\iff u\simeq v$. Each homotopy below therefore gives equality of classes by the reverse implication (`.mpr`).

Apply the following five proved Mathlib path lemmas with every endpoint specialized to $x$:

- **Left identity.** [Path.Homotopic.refl_trans](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L171-L173) gives $e_x\star p\simeq p$, hence $1\cdot A=[e_x\star p]=[p]=A$.
- **Right identity.** [Path.Homotopic.trans_refl](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L175-L177) gives $p\star e_x\simeq p$, hence $A\cdot1=[p\star e_x]=[p]=A$.
- **Right inverse.** [Path.Homotopic.trans_symm](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L179-L181) gives $p\star\bar p\simeq e_x$, hence $A\cdot A^{-1}=[p\star\bar p]=[e_x]=1$.
- **Left inverse.** [Path.Homotopic.symm_trans](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L183-L185) gives $\bar p\star p\simeq e_x$, hence $A^{-1}\cdot A=[\bar p\star p]=[e_x]=1$.
- **Associativity.** [Path.Homotopic.trans_assoc](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L187-L189) gives $(p\star q)\star r\simeq p\star(q\star r)$, hence $(A\cdot B)\cdot C=[(p\star q)\star r]=[p\star(q\star r)]=A\cdot(B\cdot C)$.

Concatenation, the constant path, and reversal are still loops based at $x$, so the operations are closed and $1\in\pi_1(X,x)$. Surjectivity of representatives makes these five identities valid for arbitrary classes. Together with the established well-definedness, they prove `FundamentalGroup.mul_assoc`, `FundamentalGroup.one_mul`, `FundamentalGroup.inv_mul`, and the group structure asserted by `FundamentalGroup.group`. This proves the section's left-to-right multiplication, rather than invoking Mathlib's default reversed End multiplication.
values.zh-CN:
沿用本节拓扑空间 $X$ 与基点 $x$ 的语境。记 $[p]=\operatorname{mk}(p)$、$e_x=\operatorname{Path.refl}(x)$、$p\star q=\operatorname{Path.trans}(p,q)$、$\bar p=\operatorname{Path.symm}(p)$；$\star$ 先走 $p$ 再走 $q$，$\simeq$ 表示定端同伦。本节已定义 $[p]\cdot[q]=[p\star q]$、$1=[e_x]$、$[p]^{-1}=[\bar p]$。乘法与取逆的代表无关性已分别由 `FundamentalGroup.mul.proof` 和 `FundamentalGroup.inv.proof` 证明，此处只验证群公理，不把道路拼接误作严格结合。

由 [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/Path.lean#L303-L308)，任取 $A,B,C\in\pi_1(X,x)$，可分别取环路 $p,q,r:x\to x$ 使 $A=[p],B=[q],C=[r]$。由 [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/Topology/Homotopy/Path.lean#L318-L319)，$[u]=[v]\iff u\simeq v$；以下每条同伦均通过此等价的反向（`.mpr`）得到类相等。

引用 Mathlib 已证明的五条道路引理，并将其中所有端点取为 $x$：

- **左单位。** [Path.Homotopic.refl_trans](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L171-L173) 给出 $e_x\star p\simeq p$，故 $1\cdot A=[e_x\star p]=[p]=A$。
- **右单位。** [Path.Homotopic.trans_refl](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L175-L177) 给出 $p\star e_x\simeq p$，故 $A\cdot1=[p\star e_x]=[p]=A$。
- **右逆。** [Path.Homotopic.trans_symm](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L179-L181) 给出 $p\star\bar p\simeq e_x$，故 $A\cdot A^{-1}=[p\star\bar p]=[e_x]=1$。
- **左逆。** [Path.Homotopic.symm_trans](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L183-L185) 给出 $\bar p\star p\simeq e_x$，故 $A^{-1}\cdot A=[\bar p\star p]=[e_x]=1$。
- **结合律。** [Path.Homotopic.trans_assoc](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8f9d9cff6bd728b17a24e163c9402775d9e6a365/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid/Basic.lean#L187-L189) 给出 $(p\star q)\star r\simeq p\star(q\star r)$，故 $(A\cdot B)\cdot C=[(p\star q)\star r]=[p\star(q\star r)]=A\cdot(B\cdot C)$。

拼接、常值与反向在这里仍是基于 $x$ 的环路，故上述运算封闭且 $1\in\pi_1(X,x)$。代表满射性使这五个等式对任意类成立；配合已证的良定义性，即得 `FundamentalGroup.mul_assoc`、`FundamentalGroup.one_mul`、`FundamentalGroup.inv_mul` 以及 `FundamentalGroup.group` 所断言的群结构。这证明的是本节“先左后右”的乘法，而非直接调用 Mathlib 默认的反序 End 群乘法。
